Erin: Kicking off LakeMaid customer story + launch webinar. Need interview slot, final pull quote from their Head of Product, legal ok on language, and a one-line benchmark for the blog. Target publish + webinar week of the 24th.

Sam: I can schedule 20-30m slots Tue/Wed afternoons PT. Tentative Wed 2:00 PM PT for Head of Product. Sending invites now.

Julia: For benchmark, I can run a quick median-latency test on their anonymized prompt set in stagingwill return a single-line stat + appendix link. Need customer permission to run.

Noor: Assets needed: final quote, 2 headshots, SVG logo, and 3 x 15s social clips. Ill mock hero art once quote is locked.

Erin: Draft quote: ```
"Redwood's latency gains let us move to near-real-time reports, which sped up our case triage."
```

legal-bot: Suggest: avoid absolutes and add attribution. Recommend: "In our tests, Redwood's latency improvements in our environment enabled near-real-time reports that helped speed case triage." Typical review 48-72h.

Erin: Updated per legal. Can we include benchmark line with "in our tests" and link to appendix?

Julia: Perf run scheduled Thu 09:00 PT. Will post results + appendix link here once complete.

Sam: Invites sent with media consent checkbox and embargo request field. Customer asked for embargo until the 24th; noted.

ops-bot: Lead routing set: utm_campaign=lakemaid_launch; tag=lakemaid-case; leads -> /queues/enterprise-sdr. Consent captured as consent_marketing=true.

Julia: Results: median token latency 96ms vs 263ms baseline -> "~2.7x median latency improvement (in our tests)." Appendix: https://app.internal/benchmarks/lakemaid-1755554321.

legal-bot: That stat is fine with attribution and appendix link. Add a one-line methodology on the landing page and ensure no PHI in artifacts. Marking ready pending customer redlines.

Noor: Headshots and logo uploaded. I'll hold social frames until final quote confirmed.

Erin: Summary: schedule done (Sam), perf stat + appendix (Julia), legal ok (legal-bot), assets uploaded (Noor), lead routing set (ops-bot), embargo 24th. Will assemble final package Mon AM. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
